description: Simple 3-phase lens for smaller teams. Unfreeze, Change, Refreeze.
name: Lewin Unfreeze / Change / Refreeze

info_icon.tooltip: ADKAR: Awareness, Desire | Kotter: Urgency, Coalition, Vision

phases.label: Unfreeze
phases.plain_english: Prepare the org. Explain why the old way can't continue.

info_icon.tooltip: ADKAR: Knowledge, Ability | Kotter: Volunteers, Action, Wins

phases.label: Change
phases.plain_english: Make the transition. Train, support, and communicate.

phases.label: Refreeze
phases.plain_english: Lock it in. Make the new way the normal way.
